The Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF

Of the eight companies reporting, six firms (75%) exceeded EPS expectations, while two fell short. Notably, seven firms (87.5%) posted Y/Y earnings growth.
Of the eight companies reporting, six firms (75%) exceeded revenue expectations, while 2 fell below analyst estimates. Notably, three firms (37.5%) posted Y/Y revenue growth.
